overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the November 17, 2025 notice listing "Open Meeting Law Determinations" under Old Business was specific enough, since the Board discussed the four complaints and counsel's draft responses.

allegations.summary: Alleged the notice topic 'Open Meeting Law Determinations' was too vague, making it appear final rather than draft town counsel responses.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notice contained sufficient specificity to reasonably advise the public of the issues to be discussed at the meeting, and thus the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
